x: Provides methods used for setting the visibility of a Game Object.The Visible component is mixed into Game Objects to give them a `visible` boolean propertyand a `setVisible` method. Visibility is tracked via a bitmask flag on `renderFlags`, sotoggling it is a fast bitwise operation. An invisible Game Object is excluded from therender pass entirely, but its `update` logic continues to run normally each frame.Should be applied as a mixin and not used directly.

m.x: The visible state of the Game Object.An invisible Game Object will skip rendering, but will still process update logic.
Sets the visibility of this Game Object.An invisible Game Object will skip rendering, but will still process update logic.

p.x: The visible state of the Game Object.
